description: This Java class implements a strategy to handle AttributeDeleted events in the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract event strategy and defines how to modify a ThingBuilder instance when an attribute is deleted.

classes.name: AttributeDeletedStrategy
classes.description: A final class implementing a specific event-handling strategy for AttributeDeleted events, modifying the state of a ThingBuilder.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to handle an AttributeDeleted event by removing the specified attribute from the ThingBuilder.
